name: cars
description: English long-form automotive videos using the exact title you submit. No title-research or title-selection gate.
channel_context: an English long-form automotive channel covering how cars work, why important models mattered, engineering tradeoffs, ownership realities, design, comparisons, and driving culture across eras
audience_line: speaks to one curious car enthusiast who values clear explanations, mechanical accuracy, useful context, and enthusiasm without brand tribalism

host.persona: A knowledgeable, even-handed automotive storyteller who explains machines with the precision of an experienced technical editor and the curiosity of a lifelong enthusiast.
host.register: Confident, visual, and accessible. Define technical terms naturally, acknowledge tradeoffs, and never turn uncertain lore into fact.

style.broll_style: cinematic real automobiles, roads, workshops, engineering details, controls and mechanical components, varied eras and environments, natural reflections, no readable logos or license plates, no impossible vehicle geometry
style.music_style: restrained modern automotive documentary score, steady percussion, subtle synth and low strings, energetic without becoming aggressive, no vocals

writing_sections.name: roadside_hook
writing_sections.hint: Open on the topic's most revealing real-world consequence or engineering question without exaggerating factual claims.

writing_sections.name: context_and_definitions
writing_sections.hint: Define the exact vehicles, generations, systems, era, and market being discussed. Explain what can vary by year, trim, engine, drivetrain, or region.

writing_sections.name: engineering_story
writing_sections.hint: Explain how the relevant systems and design decisions work, why they were chosen, and the compromises they create. Omit any specific claim that cannot be stated confidently and precisely.

writing_sections.name: real_world_meaning
writing_sections.hint: Translate the engineering and history into driving, ownership, maintenance, value, or cultural consequences without presenting anecdotes as universal evidence.

writing_sections.name: close_block
writing_sections.hint: Recap the most useful conclusion, identify remaining uncertainty honestly, invite a specific viewer perspective, and add a restrained subscription invitation. {LIKE_SUBSCRIBE}

cta_lines.like_subscribe: Invite viewers to share their experience with the exact model, era, or engineering choice, then softly ask them to subscribe for more accurate automotive stories.

north_star: Make car enthusiasm more informed. Every specification, date, comparison, and historical claim must be stated cautiously and preserve model-year, trim, drivetrain, and market distinctions.
outline_extras: Flag every numerical or historical claim that requires verification in the private outline. If a detail is uncertain, omit it instead of estimating.
rules: Never invent missing specifications or history; omit uncertain details instead of estimating.
Keep model year, generation, trim, engine, transmission, drivetrain, body style, and sales market distinct whenever they affect a claim.
Label manufacturer claims, instrumented test results, and owner anecdotes as different kinds of evidence.
Never invent performance figures, production totals, prices, recall status, quotations, awards, firsts, or rarity claims.
Do not give high-risk repair instructions or encourage illegal, reckless, or unsafe driving.
Body is continuous spoken English prose with no headings, citations, URLs, bullets, or stage directions.

hook_types.bold_statement: Open with the strongest defensible automotive implication, stated precisely rather than as an absolute.
hook_types.question: Ask a concrete engineering, history, comparison, or ownership question that the video will answer precisely.
hook_types.short_story: Open on a vivid but factual moment involving the vehicle, system, road, factory, workshop, or owner decision.
hook_types.pattern_break: Challenge a common car assumption only when the correction can be stated confidently and precisely.
